newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mortgage fund created for Mexico's Puerto Vallarta.
newsitem.headline: Mortgage fund created for Mexico's Puerto Vallarta.

text.p: Mexico's Credito Inmobiliario has created a $300 million mortgage loan fund destined for the tourist resort of Puerto Vallarta, a realtor involved in the deal said Tuesday.
Brock Squire, president of the real estate company by the same name, told Reuters in an interview the loans would be issued in dollars.
Credito Inmobiliario reached agreements with several U.S. firms, principally J.P. Morgan Investment, to create the fund.
"The initial line of credit of $300 million dollars ... could represent the start of the recovery of the construction and tourism industries" in the region, Squire said.

The program would provide 15-year mortgage loans of up to 60 percent of the value of the property for Mexicans and up to 70 percent for foreigners. --Veronica Galan, Guadalajara newsroom, (523) 817-04400
